title: gouldia kapuaensis var. rigidifolioides
intro: Gouldia kapuaensis var. rigidifolioides, commonly known as the Rigid-leaved Gouldia, is a plant species endemic to Hawaii. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and respiratory issues, due to its reported health benefits of reducing inflammation and promoting relaxation. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its antipyretic, expectorant, and anti-inflammatory properties, which help to relieve fever, congestion, and pain. The bioactive constituents of Gouldia kapuaensis var. rigidifolioides include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
